test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the first state of India to pass a law to curb lynching cases?
solution:
The correct answer is **Manipur.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lynch law** is defined as the practise of punishing people for alleged crimes or misdeeds without a fair trial.
 
• There had been no **reported kid abductions** in the** three months prior** in almost all of the lynching locations.
 
• In 2018, **the Supreme Court issued instructions for the Center and State governments** to follow when drafting laws to address the crime of lynching, describing it as a** "horrendous act of mobocracy."**
 
• The** Manipur Law **follows the rules established by the Supreme Court. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mob lynching is a flagrant breach **of the Universal Declaration of **Human Rights, Article 21 of the Constitution**, and human dignity.
 
• **Lynchings** are a particularly disturbing way for government to go astray.
 
• **Politicians** could also consider challenging the social norms that support mob violence.
